title: Man abducted off a downtown street in Concord

tellings.quote: first there was one a person in conquered California walking in the middle of the downtown streets at 4:00 a.m. had no interest in UFOs but claimed that he had been abducted right off of the street in downtown conquered and and we interviewed him.

plain: In 1976 a man walking through downtown Concord, California, at four in the morning said he had been abducted right off the street, even though he had no interest in UFOs. The parapsychologist Jeffrey Mishlove says he and his colleagues interviewed the man, and he tells it among stories linked to Ted Owens, a self-described psychic whom Mishlove studied, with a police report also part of his account.
